## English Wikipedia smoke test: According to the English Wikipedia article on 'Wikipedia', when was Wikipedia launched, who operates it, and how many articles does it contain (site:en.wikipedia.org)
**Findings (per the English Wikipedia article "Wikipedia," en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia):**

1. **Launch date:** Wikipedia was launched on **January 15, 2001**, by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, as a free, openly editable online encyclopedia. [1]

2. **Operator:** It is hosted and operated by the **Wikimedia Foundation**, an American nonprofit organization. [1]

3. **Article count:**
   - **English Wikipedia** contains **over 7 million articles** (the 7-million milestone was passed in November 2024; the count rises continuously). [1][2]
   - Across **all language editions**, Wikipedia contains **over 60 million articles** combined. [1]

**Caveats:** Article counts are dynamic and change daily; figures above reflect the most recent widely reported milestones (2024–2025). The "Wikipedia" article itself notes these numbers as approximate, citing the live statistics page for current totals. [1][2]

**Sources:**
[1] English Wikipedia article "Wikipedia" — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia
[2] Wikipedia statistics / Main Page — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Statistics

# Research Session Established ✅

**Smoke test passed.** The English Wikipedia source is reachable through the search pipeline and returning verifiable, citable results. Session is ready to accept a factual question.

---

## Session Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| **Primary source** | English Wikipedia (`en.wikipedia.org`) only |
| **Search scope** | Site-restricted queries (`site:en.wikipedia.org`) |
| **Language** | English |
| **Citation format** | Numbered references `[1]`, `[2]`, … with article titles + canonical URLs |
| **Verification** | Live smoke test completed 2026-09-26 |

## Operating Protocol for This Session

1. **Source discipline** — Every factual claim in answers will be grounded in English Wikipedia article content retrieved via search, never from memory alone.
2. **Citation standard** — Each answer carries numbered citations mapping to specific Wikipedia articles and URLs.
3. **Freshness handling** — Where Wikipedia content is dynamic (article counts, statistics, current-officeholder infoboxes), the answer will note that figures reflect the latest indexed snapshot and may have changed since.
4. **Coverage strategy** — Multi-faceted questions will be decomposed into 2–5 focused subtopic searches run in parallel, all against English Wikipedia.
5. **Transparency** — If a fact cannot be verified on English Wikipedia (or coverage is thin/contested), the answer will say so explicitly rather than filling gaps from outside the source.

## Smoke-Test Result (Verification Record)

The test query against the English Wikipedia article **"Wikipedia"** returned correctly attributed, citable content:
- Launched **January 15, 2001** by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger [1]
- Operated by the **Wikimedia Foundation**, a U.S. nonprofit [1]
- English Wikipedia holds **7+ million articles** (7-million milestone passed November 2024); all editions combined exceed **60 million** [1][2]

This confirms the pipeline resolves English Wikipedia articles, extracts facts, and produces source-linked citations as configured.

---

**Session is live.** Submit the factual question to be answered; it will be researched exclusively against English Wikipedia and returned with full citations.
